sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Semiconductor/memory faith bulls fully took over the market—QQQ +2.43% ($740) was driven almost entirely by chips, while SPY was only +0.81% ($747) and DIA was basically flat (+0.06%); SOXL surged +20%, SMH +5.67%, MU +8.9% ($1137), SNDK +11% ($2175), MRVL +13.2% ($328, new all-time high), INTC +10.3% ($133), KLAC +8.7%, TSM +6.1%, LRCX +5.6%, AMD +4.4%, NVDA +2.6% ($210). This was an extremely narrow divergence rally, with the community bluntly saying that “the entire market has been hollowed out except semis.”
  • U.S.-Iran MoU officially signed electronically (6/17): The 14-point text was released, agreeing to end hostilities within 60 days, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and have the U.S. grant sanctions waivers for Iranian crude exports. Crude extended its decline to around $75 (near year-to-date lows), USO -1.05%, XLE -1.99%. The community generally views this as “fake peace” and is waiting for Netanyahu to sabotage the agreement.
  • Warsh’s debut leaned hawkish: At Wednesday’s FOMC, rates were left unchanged for the fourth consecutive time, but 9 of 18 officials projected a rate hike this year, while the dot plot was suppressed by the new chair. Intriguingly, after overnight pricing of “possible rate hikes this year,” the market instead rallied 2%+ today, leaving the community confused.
  • SPCX crash became the biggest joke of the day: -5.95% ($180, intraday low of $172), dragging ASTS -8.2% and RKLB -3.7% down with it; rumors say the company is preparing at least a $20 billion bond issuance next week. Since the IPO (6/12), it has almost given back all its gains.
  • ACN’s epic blowup continued: -18.6% ($127), weighing on sentiment across the SaaS sector; MSTR -6.3% ($109, nearing the $100 level as BTC weakened).
  • MSFT became today’s top meme stock: +0.20% ($379), flipping back and forth around the flatline all day and getting publicly executed in the comment stream.

社区氛围：整体欢欣鼓舞，夹杂着荒谬和不信任——多头们在半导体信仰上狂欢，对SPCX的崩溃幸灾乐祸，但许多人在绿色市场中亏损，因为他们追逐了错误的名字（MSFT、空头、0DTE看跌期权），营造了一种对“市场假到极致”的疲惫氛围，并对长周末缺口持谨慎态度。

恐惧/贪婪：极度贪婪，但情绪却支离破碎。 VIX只有16，而社区同时高呼“上涨空间有限”并追逐ATH名字。该盘看起来像是一场典型的暴涨狂潮，但大多数参与者并没有获得指数级的涨幅。

情绪与实际走势：社区情绪与实际市场走势存在巨大背离——尽管QQQ+2.4%大幅上涨，但论坛的主要基调是抱怨、自嘲和对SPCX/MSFT的集体嘲笑，而不是庆祝。今天是四次巫术（季度三次到期），社区将横盘走势归咎于MM将SPY锁定在745-747美元，并表示在伽马到期后“市场将在下周失去支撑”。

SPCX70+看跌当天最大的笑话，180 美元几乎回吐 IPO 收益；以 211 美元全押的 Roth 持有者多次被处决； 200亿美元债券发行=稀释；空头呼吁 50-135 美元/零，而逆向投资者押注周一跳空 V 型复苏
MU35+强烈看涨记忆信仰交易核心，1137美元；要求1500-2000美元； 6/24的盈利是试金石，但人们担心“击败后抛售”魔咒； DRAM ETF/leaps 是印钞机
